introHtml: Plastic bar wine glasses are a practical choice for outdoor events, poolside promotions, and venues where glass is prohibited. Unlike standard drinkware, these shatterproof options allow guests to enjoy wine or champagne without risk. The 12 oz Oceanworks Stemless Wine Glass offers a sustainable option made from recycled ocean plastics, while the Vinello and Reserv styles provide elegant stemless designs suitable for corporate branding. Custom imprinting ensures your logo stands out on every piece.
